mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.app_user (id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, email, mfa_secret, mfa_enabled, created_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{tenantId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{email}, #{mfaSecret}, #{mfaEnabled}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
